subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should OpenClaw adopt Home as the sole Wear surface for agent, session, and model selection, with model controls introduced through the paired Phone/Wear `model-controls` capability contract?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately changing navigation and adding a persistent paired-app protocol surface; tests and recordings support the mechanics, but only the product owner can accept the long-term UX and upgrade contract.

options.title: Accept after upgrade refresh
options.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result on current `main`, rerun focused paired-version validation, and approve Home as the consolidated context-selection surface.

options.title: Keep dedicated pages
options.body: Request a narrower variant that retains Agent and Session pages while adding only the desired Home shortcuts or model control.

recommendation.title: Accept after upgrade refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result on current `main`, rerun focused paired-version validation, and approve Home as the consolidated context-selection surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the substantive correctness follow-ups on the affected Phone/Wear contract.
